params.caption: 🎮 Arc Raiders passes 17 million sales on its first birthday Embark Studios' extraction shooter Arc Raiders has sold more than 17 million copies, publisher Nexon revealed as the game marks one year since launch. Nexon also expects the game's revenue to decline going forward. 🕒 Nov 10, 2026 · 15:28 (GMT+3) 📰 Source: Eurogamer #ArcRaiders #Nexon #GamingNews
